blending.en: No blending task: the EGRA Toolkit 2016 has none (core subtasks pp.39-40; phonemic-awareness options Exhibit 9 p.41; Annex H pp.187-198), nor the Rawalpindi May 2026 instrument (17 subtasks).
blending.ur: No blending task: the national Urdu EGRA has none (PRP 2020, PA00Z7MW Table 1), Sindh SELECT 2024 says it was not included (p.47), and the Rawalpindi May 2026 instrument has none.
blending.src: egra_tk2016:pp.39-41, Annex H; prpkp2020_report:Table 1; select2024:p.47; rwp2026:administration_order

letter_names.note: five letters of the Rawalpindi grid, none of them in the letter-sound set (the Toolkit gives names and sounds separate grids, Annex H pp.211/213)

practice.why: no Urdu letter-sound practice item is printed in a source we hold: a grid letter outside the scored five, used for its sound

letter_sounds.no_sound_rule: Letter-sound items use only letters with a consonant sound of their own: not ء ع ں ے ھ or the vowel letters ا آ و ی, and only the common member of a class that shares one sound (س not ث ص; ز not ذ ض ظ; ت not ط; ہ not ح).
letter_sounds.deviation: the national Urdu EGRA and the Rawalpindi instrument test letter NAMES (PRP 2020 Table 1; rwp2026:letterid_urd); no published Urdu letter-sound grid or rule exists, so these are the Rawalpindi grid's own letters used for their sound (ب م ک س ر, row 1), matching Sindh SELECT's initial-sound keys (pp.100-101)
